# Miles Sound System 6.1c

The oldest of the three Miles SDKs on the library path (mss32.dll 6.1c, 16-Oct-01). The game takes the three Miles
imports of reswave.cpp (`AIL_mem_free_lock`, `AIL_decompress_ADPCM`, `AIL_decompress_ASI`) from its `lib/mss32.lib`,
the unmodified vendor library. `include/mss.h` is kept for reference only and is not on the include path.
